$comment: Phase 02 §A–M acceptance criteria, the 15 architectural invariants and the L12 acceptance list resolved against repository artefacts. Verified four ways: pasted document, architecture/phase-02-identity.md (2,477 lines), frontend/src/lib/kernel/phase-contracts/phase-02-identity.ts, architecture/registry.json.

documentIntegrity.finding: The pasted Phase 02 document is structurally degraded: A5/A6, C5/C6, E3, the F2 operation input/output tables, H2–H17 field lists, I8, J16, K2/K7/K8, M2, the Definition-of-Done table and the invariant bodies arrived empty. The repository document is authoritative and complete; the paste cannot be used verbatim as the acceptance source.

ownership.note: Phase 02 owns identity representation, authentication, credential lifecycle, relationships and verification. It never owns tenant isolation (03), security enforcement (08/09), domain data (04+) or AI reasoning (07/26).

areas.requirement: A canonical repository of identity records with kinds for every actor type and a deterministic lookup.
Creation, verification, activation, suspension, recovery, deletion and archival are policy-controlled transitions.
Credential metadata (never plaintext secrets) with rotation, revocation and recovery.
Login verification with rate limiting, lockout and password reset semantics.
Sessions support expiration, revocation, device tracking and audit.
Identity supplies the actor; authorization decisions are made by the security engine, never by a role check alone.
Relationships (guardian_of, teaches, manages, assigned_to) are first-class authorization inputs.

areas.area: Agent identity contract (F9) — agents are accountable principals
areas.requirement: Every agent has identity, owner, permissions, tools, memory scope, risk class and approval rules; no agent exceeds them.
Physical devices have identity, tenant, operator, lifecycle and trust state; a device is not commanded merely because it is reachable.

Attributable identity for every actor; no authorization on a username or role alone; agents governed; identity owns no domain data; tenant isolation belongs to 03; security operations to 08/09; identity replaceable; credentials never ordinary metadata; privileged operations attributable; contracts versioned; lifecycle policy-controlled; no silent agent escalation; trust contextual; institutional sovereignty; global evolution without a rewrite.

areas.area: Workspace projection (identity visible in a surface)
areas.requirement: The identity capability is projected in at least one workspace from real state (L4), not only in the backend.
areas.boundaryNote: The `/admin/identities` L4 surface was removed with the hardcoded portal UI (2026-10-26). Identity registry functions and tests remain; workspace projection is IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED until a governed replacement surface exists.

areas.requirement: IdentityCreated, IdentityVerified, CredentialChanged, PermissionChanged, RelationshipCreated, IdentitySuspended and IdentityDeleted are emitted and versioned.
areas.boundaryNote: The event contract is DECLARED by the phase contract but nothing implements it: no IdentityCreated/CredentialChanged event is emitted anywhere, and no boundary probe is declared because there is no implementation to invoke. Registered as owned debt (02).
